settings.heading: Look. Ask. Capture.
settings.text: An 8MP camera, open-ear audio and a voice assistant you wake by saying Hey Turbo.

settings.heading: Ask what you're looking at.
settings.text: Directional microphones pull your voice out of a noisy street, and the answer plays at your ear.

settings.heading: Everyday
settings.text: For the commute, the trip and the table.

settings.heading: Cycling
settings.text: For the ride, the run and the climb.

settings.heading: Ski & Snow
settings.text: Record the mountain from your point of view.

settings.question: What is the difference between Everyday and Sport?
settings.answer: Everyday frames are designed for daily wear; Sport frames use a wraparound shape for active use.

settings.question: Will people know when I am recording?
settings.answer: Yes. A visible indicator light comes on whenever the camera is running.

settings.question: Are they safe in rain?
settings.answer: Check the IP rating on each product page before using them in wet conditions.
